data.title: Braves flamethrower expected to be ready for opening playoff series after returning from injury - sportingnews.com
data.content: # Braves flamethrower expected to be ready for opening playoff series after returning from injury. The Atlanta Braves are starting to get some of their key players healthy as they prepare for the postseason. Before the injury bug hit the team in full force, the bullpen was arguably the most dominant part of the Braves' roster. The injury occurred in June, and it didn’t seem to be as serious at first. However, it turned out to be a pretty significant injury, as Suarez would miss months of time. Atlanta used this week to see if Suarez would be ready for the playoffs after only being back for less than a week. Suarez is ready for the playoffs, and the Braves hope he can have the same success he did before he was injured. This is a huge get for Atlanta, as the starting rotation took a massive hit by losing Martin Perez for at least the opening series of the playoffs.

data.content: U.S. Men's National Soccer Team. # USMNT projected lineup vs Chile: Will Pochettino rotate his side? The U.S. men's national team looks to make it two wins from two in the post-World Cup era on Tuesday, Sept. 29, as it hosts Chile in St. Louis. In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park.
